title: Subagent tools on by default, standard suite
note: The candidate shipped the subagent tools in every session. Every sample of both arms succeeded and requests did not change; total tokens rose 12 to 19% on every model, the cost of about 1.7 KB of tool definitions (toolSchemaChars 4.1-4.3k to 5.8-6.0k) on these short tasks. The gemini-3.8-flash-high tool-error rise (1 to 3) is `git` run outside a repository, a bash exit the native arm counts as an error, unrelated to the change. This cost is why D38 puts the tools behind the subagents setting; this step is superseded by the record above it.

settings.effort: each route's effort is in routes: medium by default, DeepSeek high (it has no medium), and an EVAL_MODELS @<effort> replaces either

regressionRule: all tasks, per model: total tokens with the 95% interval above zero; requests up more than 10% with the 95% interval above zero; failures +2 or more; any tool-error increase
